area: SMS / Telegram / Line / TikTok / API / Twitter channels

rows.note: Generic SMS API channel (Bandwidth-style); delivery-status webhook maps message-delivered/failed onto Message#status.

One Channel::TwilioSms serves both mediums (sms/whatsapp); webhooks land on app/controllers/twilio/ callback + delivery_status controllers, and whatsapp_identifier_helper owns the BSUID-vs-phone identity problem.
Syncs approved Content Templates onto channel.content_templates and provisions the CSAT survey call-to-action template.
Audience-label blast sends with per-contact rescue; invoked from the campaigns feature's scheduling side.
Handles Telegram Business payloads (agent-sent echoes stored as outgoing) and edited_message sync by source_id.
Stickers rendered as markdown images off LINE's CDN; outbound deliberately uses permanent file_url over 5-min signed download_url.
Short-lived tokens refreshed lazily under a Redis lock via Tiktok::TokenService; both-expired triggers prompt_reauthorization!.
image_send_capable? probed once and cached on the conversation; text and attachment are mutually exclusive per send.

rows.capability: API channel: custom-channel conversations & email continuity
rows.note: Messages arrive via the REST API and leave via account webhooks; the flag gates only the email-continuity fallback notification.
Legacy Account Activity API (webhook enters via Api::V1::WebhooksController#twitter_events, not app/controllers/webhooks/); treat as lower-confidence given X API changes.

rows.capability: Facebook & Instagram: Facebook Page connect & inbox setup
rows.note: OAuth Page picker + inbox creation (register_facebook_page); subscribe/unsubscribe swallow errors silently.
Inbound is the facebook-messenger gem's server mounted at /bot, not a Rails webhook controller.
Token invalidation is string-matched (not numeric code) before triggering authorization_error!.

rows.capability: Facebook & Instagram: Instagram webhook ingress & event dispatch
rows.note: find_channel prefers Channel::Instagram, falls back to Channel::FacebookPage, then dispatches to the matching connection-mode services.

rows.capability: Facebook & Instagram: Instagram direct login connection
rows.note: Standalone Instagram Login OAuth with long-lived token refresh; access_token can return nil when expired.
Channel::Instagram path via graph.instagram.com with the channel's own token; codes 9010/100 become synthetic Unknown contacts.

rows.capability: Facebook & Instagram: Instagram via Facebook Page messaging
rows.note: Page-linked mode via Koala/graph.facebook.com with page_access_token + appsecret_proof — do not conflate with direct login.
Maps Meta delivery/read watermarks to Conversations::UpdateMessageStatusJob; IG payload shape is shared across both connection modes.

rows.capability: Facebook & Instagram: Human Agent tag (24h window extension)
rows.note: Gated by GlobalConfig keys ENABLE_MESSENGER_CHANNEL_HUMAN_AGENT / ENABLE_INSTAGRAM_CHANNEL_HUMAN_AGENT (Super Admin app configs), not features.yml.
Portal CRUD: slug, locales, layout (classic/documentation), color/logo branding, analytics snippets, and per-locale popular-content recommendations, all schema-validated via PortalConfigSchema.
Locale-scoped categories with three distinct self-referential links: parent/sub hierarchy, cross-locale associated categories, and RelatedCategory join for related topics.
Draft/published/archived workflow with per-locale draft publishing, hand-rolled position rebalancing (not acts_as_list), and cross-locale linked translations via associated_article_id.
Server-rendered Turbo/ERB site with small Vue islands (search, TOC, theme toggle) reading window.portalConfig; on Cloud the flag gate returns 402 not_active when help_center is off.

OSS path is pg_search text_search (public portal search + agent-side SearchService); Enterprise pgvector vector_search is gated by help_center_embedding_search, a manual-only flag granted by no plan tier.
Portal#custom_domain changes enqueue Cloudflare custom-hostname verification on Chatwoot Cloud only; ssl_settings jsonb lives on Portal.
show_plain_layout=true switches rendering to the :plain variant (chrome-less layout, X-Frame-Options removed) for embedding articles inside the web widget or an iframe.
Per-inbox csat_survey_enabled + csat_config jsonb (display_type emoji/star, message, button_text, label-based survey_rules, template) permitted/normalized in InboxesController#format_csat_config.

conversation_status_changed → eligibility checks (enabled, not tweet, not already sent, label survey_rules, messaging window) → input_csat message, WhatsApp/Twilio template fallback, or a not-sent activity message.
Creates/status-checks the auto-generated versioned CSAT template on the WABA (or Twilio Content API) so resolved conversations outside the 24h window still get a survey.
AI pre-check (analyze action, 403 without captain_integration) scoring a draft CSAT template against a rubric before submitting it to Meta.
Standalone Vue SPA keyed by conversation UUID (not a survey id); GET/PATCH /public/api/v1/csat_survey/:uuid with rating+feedback, edits 422-locked after 14 days.
message_updated on the input_csat message upserts CsatSurveyResponse (unique per message, snapshots assigned agent) — the rows CSAT reports aggregate.
Enterprise-only update of csat_review_notes on a response with review_notes_updated_by/at audit fields.
Realtime Overview page (LiveReports.vue): open/unattended conversation metrics and agent/team/inbox-grouped metrics computed live from conversations, not reporting_events.
Core index/summary metrics; Reports::DataSource.for still always returns RawDataSource — the rollup-backed read path is not wired.
Two generations coexist: revised index-table summaries via V2::Reports::*SummaryBuilder, while legacy V2::ReportBuilder still powers the old entity pages and the conversations action.
Click a chart bucket to see underlying conversations/messages/events; admin-only at both controller and UI level.
bot_summary/bot_metrics actions over bot_resolutions_count/bot_handoffs_count; handoff uniqueness enforced by DISTINCT conversation_id, not the DB.
Server-generated CSV exports (agents/inboxes/labels/teams/conversations_summary/conversation_traffic); CSAT and SLA have their own download actions on their controllers.

rows.capability: Reports: metric event capture & rollups (write path)
rows.note: ReportingEvent + ReportingEventsRollup producers; rollup writes run unconditionally (report_rollup only ever gates the not-yet-wired read side) and BackfillService has no scheduler/job caller.
voice_enabled toggle on Channel::TwilioSms provisions/tears down the TwiML app; inboxes_controller adds the 'voice' channel type and calling toggles.

rows.capability: Voice: Twilio call webhooks & call legs
rows.note: TwiML call/status webhooks resolve inbound/outbound/agent legs; returns empty TwiML when inbound calls are disabled on the inbox.
Join/leave/end Twilio conferences per call; case-store evidence of orphaned-conference hold-music failure modes lives here.

rows.capability: Voice: call lifecycle & status (shared Call model)
rows.note: Unified Twilio+WhatsApp Call record with status transitions and the voice_call message bubble builder.

initiate/accept/reject/terminate against Graph API calling endpoints; field=calls webhooks routed under a per-call_id Redis mutex; docs/WHATSAPP_CALL_ARCHITECTURE.md is authoritative for the media plane.
Meta requires user-granted permission before business-initiated calls; request/interactive-reply flow intercepted from the WhatsApp events job.
Recording-status webhook handling, recording attachment onto the call message, and the async transcription pipeline.
Account-wide call list only for admins/report_manage custom roles; others see calls they handled within permitted conversations.

rows.capability: Voice: agent call session (browser SDK & tokens)
rows.note: Shared frontend session state (global join lock, duration timer) over Twilio Voice SDK and WhatsApp WebRTC; token_service mints the short-lived Voice Grant JWTs.

rows.capability: Website live chat: visitor session & auth token
rows.note: Bootstrap config call creates contact/contact_inbox and mints the per-visitor JWT (X-Auth-Token); expired/garbage tokens silently behave like a brand-new anonymous visitor.
Conversation create/resolve/typing/read/transcript plus message CRUD; conversation scope widens to all hmac_verified contact_inboxes when the session is verified.

rows.capability: Website live chat: SDK embed & public JS API
rows.note: window.$chatwoot API (setUser/setCustomAttributes/toggle/reset) and the string-matched postMessage bridge; every platform install guide reduces to chatwootSDK.run({websiteToken, baseUrl}).

rows.capability: Website live chat: widget app (in-iframe UI)
rows.note: The Vue 3 app inside the iframe: chat UI, Vuex store, /api/v1/widget/* REST clients, and the ActionCable subscriber mirroring agent-side message/typing/presence events.

rows.capability: Website live chat: continuity via email
rows.note: Gated by the per-inbox continuity_via_email toggle (not a features.yml flag — email_continuity_on_api_channel gates only the API-channel sibling); input_email content_type in messages#update captures the visitor's address.

rows.capability: Website live chat: dark mode & appearance
rows.note: darkMode light/auto/dark threaded from chatwootSettings through config-set postMessage to the appConfig store; runtime switch via $chatwoot.setColorScheme().

rows.capability: Website live chat: campaigns on widget
rows.note: Client-side delivery of ongoing campaigns (URL match + delay timer, cookie-based snooze); authoring/triggering lives in the Campaigns rows.
Two setup modes: forward-to the auto-generated forward_to_email (ActionMailbox path) vs direct IMAP/SMTP with manual or OAuth credentials.
Forwarded/relay mail path; BCC routing is gated by the SKIP_INCOMING_BCC_PROCESSING global config, not a feature flag.
Strategy chain (reply+uuid / In-Reply-To / References / new-conversation) shared by both the ActionMailbox and IMAP paths.
Scheduled poller bypassing ActionMailbox entirely; Imap::ImapMailbox is a plain Ruby class, not an ActionMailbox mailbox.
OAuth connect + callback builds/finds the Channel::Email with XOAUTH2 IMAP config; Microsoft::RefreshOauthTokenService mirrors the Google refresh service.
Builds threading headers (Message-Id/In-Reply-To/References) that the inbound matching strategies parse on the way back in.
reply+<uuid>@inbound_email_domain addressing round-trips via ReceiverUuidStrategy; API-channel continuity has its own flag, widget uses channel.continuity_via_email.
DB-backed Liquid templates/layouts win over filesystem views, resolved inbox → account → installation scope order.
ResponseBuilderJob branches v1 (chat + action classifier) vs v2 (tool-using agent runner); captain_integration_v2 is eligibility-gated, not in any plan array.
Guardrails/auto_resolve_mode/inactivity threshold live on Captain::Assistant; LLM-evaluated completion needs captain_tasks + assistant config, else pure time-based.
PerformSyncJob layers permanent-discard/transient-retry/catch-all policies under a per-document Redis lock; Firecrawl webhook feeds the crawl pipeline.
CaptainListener enqueues ConversationFaqJob on conversation_resolved when the assistant's feature_faq config is on; suggestions are permission-scoped via FaqSuggestionFinder.
Controller allows either flag; user-defined HTTP tools with Liquid templating, SSRF-guarded endpoints (SafeEndpointValidatable), 15-per-account cap.
OSS lib/captain task services behind the tasks controller (also label_suggestion/follow_up/overview_summary/csat_utility_analysis); captain_tasks ships enabled by default.
Per-plan CAPTAIN_CLOUD_PLAN_LIMITS (not a feature-flag array); usage_limits gates document/response creation; credit delta math has a known stuck-at-0 bug history.
Precedence: account captain_models override > hardcoded gpt-5.2 for v2-flagged assistant feature > llm.yml default; credit_multiplier per model is advertised here, not debited.
Redis-backed, event-driven count cache (18-file subsystem); unread_count_for_filters gates only the saved-filter count variant.
Per-channel can_reply? rule (WhatsApp/Twilio 24h, TikTok 48h, Messenger/Instagram 24h-or-7d, API custom window); Conversation#can_reply? delegates here.
Dispatcher-only websocket broadcast (no DB writes), toggled from both agent dashboard and widget/public API controllers.
Not a features.yml flag: Cloud gates via the Enterprise email_transcript_enabled? override (paid plans only, plan_name vs default plan), OSS always allows.
Shared BulkActionsController dispatches by type; the conversation path runs top-level BulkActionsJob, kept separate from the contacts bulk subsystem.
Contacts-list multi-select toolbar: BulkActionService fans out to bulk delete / label add / label remove services with non-uniform return contracts.
Agent-initiated dashboard merge; reassigns conversations/messages/notes/contact_inboxes via bulk .update (skips callbacks) then destroys the mergee.
Widget setUser/identify flow: auto-merges duplicate contacts by identifier > email > phone priority before applying attribute updates.

Per-store OAuth connect plus customer-order lookup in the conversation sidebar; the webhooks controller only handles Shopify's shop/redact GDPR topic (destroys the Integrations::Hook), and availability also requires SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID global config.

Pushes contacts as LeadSquared leads and posts conversation-created/transcript activities; HookJob wraps calls in a per-hook Redis mutex to prevent duplicate-lead races, and Crm::SetupJob provisions activity types on hook creation.

OAuth connect/disconnect storing an Integrations::Hook (app_id 'notion', requires NOTION_CLIENT_ID); no HookJob processor or lib/enterprise consumer exists yet, so the hook is consumed from the frontend only.

rows.capability: Automation rules: rule engine (events, conditions, actions)
rows.note: Event-triggered immediate rules; shares the base ActionService action vocabulary with macros, and Enterprise adds the add_sla action via Enterprise::ActionService.
Episode-keyed pending-execution queue with fire-time re-checks; read AutomationRulePendingExecution directly before touching episode-key mechanics.
Conditions are re-validated at match time; two consecutive failures auto-disable the rule and email account admins via Reauthorizable.
Synchronous single-conversation assignment inside the Conversation save callback; default path when assignment_v2 is off, toggled per-inbox via enable_auto_assignment.

SKIP LOCKED bulk claim driven by AssignmentPolicy; Enterprise overlay (enterprise/app/services/enterprise/auto_assignment/) adds balanced selection and capacity filtering under advanced_assignment (see Agent capacity limits row).
Redis-backed per-inbox rotation shared by both V1 and V2; self-heals membership from inbox_members but resets order on Redis flush.
